finding.claim: TOTP second factor can be guessed without a per-account limit: failed codes are audited but never counted, and the pending session is not invalidated, so an attacker who knows the password can keep guessing across fresh logins.
finding.source: code form field on POST /ui/login/totp (handlers.go:125), reachable with a valid password
finding.sink: verifyTOTPWithTimestep check at handlers.go:130 (second factor for login)

trace.note: auth rate limit 5 req/s burst 10 per IP (ratelimit/limiter.go:47)
PendingOperator resolves the pending session from cookie
TOTP verify with skew ±1 (totp.go:40)
on failure: audit row and re-render only; no failure counter, no session invalidation
lockout counter only incremented on password mismatch
correct password resets failure counter and creates a fresh 5-minute pending session (session.go:23,174)

finding.guards_checked: Replay protection on consumed timestep (handlers.go:135); per-IP rate limit; 5-minute pending TTL. None caps total guesses per account. Approx 1500 guesses per pending session per IP at 5/s, ~3/1e6 hit chance each, scaling across IPs.

finding.claim: OIDC-authenticated operators are exempt from the enforce-2FA redirect, and the OIDC callback never checks TOTPEnabled, so IdP-only login skips local second factor.
finding.source: Successful OIDC callback for an operator with AuthProvider=oidc
finding.sink: Authenticated session creation without local 2FA (requireAuth bypass)

trace.note: requireAuth skips enforce-2FA when AuthProvider == OIDC
StartAuthenticatedSession called without checking op.TOTPEnabled
creates AuthenticatedSession directly, no pending_totp state

finding.guards_checked: IdP-side MFA is assumed by design; email_verified and allowlist checks apply (oidc.go:305-325). Impact depends on IdP MFA strength. Policy decision, not a code bug per se.

finding.claim: Malformed or unusable stored firewall policy silently falls back to allow-all outbound, and the mobile bundle builder discards the error, so a restrictive egress policy becomes allow-all.
finding.source: network_config 'firewall' JSON row (stored data; corrupt or legacy)
finding.sink: Rendered agent/mobile Nebula config outbound firewall rules

trace.note: JSON parse error returns DefaultFirewallOutbound (allow-all)
convertStoredRules error also returns defaults
error discarded with _; no logger, silent default
agent path only logs a warning, still renders baseline

finding.guards_checked: Write-time validation requires non-empty port, proto, group (internal/api/firewall.go:96-113). Only triggered by corrupted or pre-validation stored rows.

finding.claim: Disabled OIDC operators receive a new authenticated session and a success audit row on callback, because upsertOperator and StartAuthenticatedSession do not check operator status.
finding.source: OIDC callback for an operator whose status is disabled but still allowed by the IdP
finding.sink: Session row creation, last-login update, and operator.oidc.login audit entry

trace.note: upsertOperator called
GetOperatorByOIDC returns operator without status check
StartAuthenticatedSession creates session
UpdateOperatorLastLogin for disabled account
audit operator.oidc.login written as success

finding.guards_checked: CurrentOperator rejects inactive operators (sqlite_operators.go:711), so no access is granted. Impact is misleading audit and orphaned sessions that revive on re-enable before expiry.

finding.claim: OIDC authorization request omits a nonce and the ID token nonce is never validated, a defense-in-depth gap in the OIDC flow.
finding.source: OIDC login initiation and callback id_token

trace.note: AuthCodeURL(state) with no nonce
verifier.Verify without nonce check
state cookie binding enforced (cookie == state)

finding.guards_checked: State cookie binding blocks login CSRF (oidc.go:208-210); token obtained over TLS from IdP; aud verified by verifier. Low practical impact.

finding.claim: Any unauthenticated attacker who knows a username can lock that local account, including admin accounts, for 15 minutes every 10 failed attempts.
finding.source: Unauthenticated POST /ui/login with a known username and wrong password

trace.note: RecordFailedLoginAttempt increments counter on wrong password
lock applied at threshold 10 for 15 minutes
active lock denies login regardless of password

finding.guards_checked: Timing equalized via dummy bcrypt (#180); per-IP rate limit 5/s. Deliberate trade-off per #263; listed for awareness.

finding.claim: Self-registration auto-provisions a CA key for each new account, letting unauthenticated callers consume CPU and storage by creating accounts, if self-registration is enabled.
finding.source: Unauthenticated POST /ui/register when self-registration is enabled
finding.sink: provisionDefaultCA key generation and CA row creation

trace.note: gated by allowSelfRegistrationEffective
operator.self_register audit then provisionDefaultCA
auth rate limit 5/s burst 10 per IP

finding.guards_checked: Auth rate limit and password policy apply. Default value of self-registration not verified.
